mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.pid, d.drawing_type, d.item_name, d.model, d.dwg_file_id, d.pdf_file_id, d.status, d.create_time, d.update_time, dwg_file.file_url as dwg_file_url, dwg_file.file_name as dwg_file_name, pdf_file.file_url as pdf_file_url, pdf_file.file_name as pdf_file_name FROM doc_prod_drawing d LEFT JOIN file_info dwg_file ON d.dwg_file_id = dwg_file.id LEFT JOIN file_info pdf_file ON d.pdf_file_id = pdf_file.id WHERE d.id = #{id}

SELECT d.id, d.pid, d.drawing_type, d.item_name, d.model, d.dwg_file_id, d.pdf_file_id, d.status, d.create_time, d.update_time, dwg_file.file_url as dwg_file_url, dwg_file.file_name as dwg_file_name, pdf_file.file_url as pdf_file_url, pdf_file.file_name as pdf_file_name FROM doc_prod_drawing d LEFT JOIN file_info dwg_file ON d.dwg_file_id = dwg_file.id LEFT JOIN file_info pdf_file ON d.pdf_file_id = pdf_file.id ORDER BY d.create_time DESC
